name: satin-pro-styles
title: Satin Pro styles
description: Satin Pro's own classes and component CSS, precompiled: only what Satin styles doesn't already have. Import it after satin.css.

/* @uisatin/pro: load after @uisatin/ui/styles.css. */
/*! tailwindcss v4.3.4 | MIT License | https://tailwindcss.com */@layer components;@layer utilities{.sa\:z-20{z-index:20}.sa\:mx-1{margin-inline:var(--sa-spacing)}.sa\:-ms-2{margin-inline-start:calc(var(--sa-spacing) * -2)}.sa\:mt-3{margin-top:calc(var(--sa-spacing) * 3)}.sa\:bg-component-changes-review-source-bg{background-color:var(--sa-component-changes-review-source-bg)}.sa\:p-1\.5{padding:calc(var(--sa-spacing) * 1.5)}.sa\:line-through{text-decoration-line:line-through}.sa\:\[\&_svg\]\:text-text-destructive svg{color:var(--sa-text-destructive)}}.satin-bulk-action-bar{transition:opacity var(--sa-duration-slow) var(--sa-ease-out), transform var(--sa-duration-slow) var(--sa-ease-out), visibility 0s}.satin-bulk-action-bar[data-state=closed]{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity var(--sa-duration-slow) var(--sa-ease-out), transform var(--sa-duration-slow) var(--sa-ease-out), visibility 0s linear var(--sa-duration-slow);transform:translateY(8px)}.satin-bulk-roll{display:inline-grid;overflow:clip}.satin-bulk-roll>*{grid-area:1/1}.satin-bulk-roll[data-dir=up]>[data-roll=out]{animation:satin-bulk-roll-out-up var(--sa-duration-fast) var(--sa-ease-out) forwards}.satin-bulk-roll[data-dir=up]>[data-roll=in]{animation:satin-bulk-roll-in-up var(--sa-duration-fast) var(--sa-ease-out)}.satin-bulk-roll[data-dir=down]>[data-roll=out]{animation:satin-bulk-roll-out-down var(--sa-duration-fast) var(--sa-ease-out) forwards}.satin-bulk-roll[data-dir=down]>[data-roll=in]{animation:satin-bulk-roll-in-down var(--sa-duration-fast) var(--sa-ease-out)}@keyframes satin-bulk-roll-in-up{0%{transform:translateY(100%)}}@keyframes satin-bulk-roll-out-up{to{transform:translateY(-100%)}}@keyframes satin-bulk-roll-in-down{0%{transform:translateY(-100%)}}@keyframes satin-bulk-roll-out-down{to{transform:translateY(100%)}}.satin-changes-review-row [data-slot=agent-suggestion-change-value]>:last-child{transition:color var(--sa-duration-base) var(--sa-ease-out), filter var(--sa-duration-base) var(--sa-ease-out)}.satin-changes-review-row[data-state=rejected] [data-slot=agent-suggestion-change-value]>:last-child{color:var(--sa-text-muted);filter:grayscale()}.satin-changes-review-exit{opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity var(--sa-duration-base) var(--sa-ease-out), transform var(--sa-duration-base) var(--sa-ease-out);transform:translateY(-4px)}
